title: Stabilize candidate test execution after Stage relocations
goal: Preserve CandidateTests argument arrays and keep its Diff-consumption policy-move fixture valid for either supported policy layout.
acceptanceCriteria: A test command with no arguments receives none.
A test command with one switch receives the complete switch as one argument.
Multi-argument CrossPlatform commands preserve argument order and values.
The Diff-consumption fixture resolves the single active policy root and tests a move to the alternate layout.
The complete Architecture and CrossPlatform candidate suites pass.
Trusted-component authorization is consumed exactly once and candidate parity passes.
